notablePrerequisites: You've had at least two creatures die under your control this turn.
description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Nevinyrral.
When Nevinyrral enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
